evidence.field: 說文釋形; 注音; 釋義
evidence.text: The 請 entry reports the Shuowen gloss 謁也 and analysis 从言，青聲 (Duan edition: 靑聲). It gives readings qǐng, qīng, qíng, and separately lists senses including entreat/request, engage, invite, petition, inquire, greet, welcome a deity, and a respectful request. These dictionary senses do not establish a chronology of semantic extension.
evidence.title: [A03849] 請 - 教育部《異體字字典》

evidence.source: Ministry of Education, Taiwan, Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants
evidence.field: 說文釋形; 字樣說明; 注音
evidence.text: The 青 entry reports the Shuowen analysis of 青 as 从生、丹, gives its modern Mandarin reading qīng, and explicitly identifies 青 as the shared component in characters including 請. This supports 青's presence and modern reading, while the 請 entry supplies the explicit sound-component analysis.
evidence.title: [A04499] 青 - 教育部《異體字字典》

evidence.source: Baxter and Sagart, Old Chinese: A New Reconstruction, 2014 table
evidence.text: The table gives 青 qīng, MC tsheng, OC *[s.r̥]ˤeŋ; 請 qíng, MC dzjeng, OC *m-tsʰeŋ; and 請 qǐng, MC tshjengX, OC *[tsʰ]eŋʔ. This system-specific comparison supports a historical sound relationship compatible with the stated phonetic role, but does not by itself prove the graph's formation date or establish a semantic chronology.
evidence.title: Baxter-Sagart Old Chinese reconstruction, version 1.1 (20 September 2014)

evidence.text: The exact file page identifies the asset as a vector depiction of 請 in Shuowen seal-script style, says it is based on a Sinica database image, and states CC0 licensing. File history dates the modern vector upload to 30 September 2023. It is a modern redraw of a seal-style form, not a photograph of an ancient artifact.

gaps: No character-specific dated specimen sequence for 請 was verified; the Shuowen analysis establishes a historical lexicographic account, not earliest graphic attestation. No graphic corruption or transitional component change is established.

The Shuowen gloss 謁也 and the MOE entry's quotations do not establish the earliest word use or date of each sense. The ordering of entreating, engaging, inviting, petitioning, inquiring, greeting, welcoming deities, and polite-request uses remains unknown.
The qīng 請室 reading and qíng uses glossed as 通情 and 通擎 are separate dictionary-recorded uses; their relation to the qǐng lexeme is not established here.

Local data supplied exact kMandarin rows 請=qǐng and 请=qǐng and exact Baxter–Sagart rows for 請. These are dataset checks, not external evidence. Official Unihan pages failed to open, so no Unicode per-character reading records are emitted. The local Baxter–Sagart table did not include 青; the externally inspected 2014 table gives 青 *[s.r̥]ˤeŋ, which differs in notation and form from the 請 readings but provides a same-system historical comparison.

No bulk extract is recommended: the accessed materials are character-specific references and their reuse terms do not establish a clear need or permission for a tracked corpus extract. The proposed Commons glyph is CC0; it is a modern vector redraw, not an artifact photograph.

items.selection_reason: The page identifies the graph, style, Sinica-derived source, direct original file, and CC0 terms. It offers a useful visual reference for the traditional graph while being clearly labelled as a modern redraw, not an excavated artifact.

limitations.text: No ancient artifact photograph or independently dated pre-seal specimen was verified; the selected illustration is a modern vector depiction of a seal-style graph.
The Xiaoxuetang page labels its record 小篆 / 說文‧言部 and its official notice releases queried glyph images under CC0, but the direct image fetch failed, so that candidate is not included.
